source: All observation-key deduplicated transactions on target date
currency: Source: paid/payment currency; destination: received/receiving currency; aggregation always within currency.
zero_missing: Missing opposite flow has zero ratio and zero count.
same_minute: Every same-minute event is included, with no cap.
self_transfer: Appears once on each directional side, as one debit and one credit.
normalization: Ratio to that account/currency mean on same day; no cross-date fitting.
